## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Include an example
when it makes the change easier to assess.

## Verification

List the checks run, the environment, and the relevant evidence. Identify skipped
or unavailable checks. Distinguish automated fixtures from genuine-input proof.

## Data and compatibility

Describe any schema, API, source-data, review-state, or operational impact.
For moved or retired files, identify the new owner and retained evidence.

## Documentation

Link the current document updated for this behavior and any dated checkpoint.
